result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with consistent styling. One notable issue is a duplicated restaurant entry in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, delivery time (15-25 min), and delivery fee (€0.90 delivery), appearing to be an unintended duplicate.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source for duplicates and ensure each carousel entry represents a unique restaurant, or differentiate the entries if they are distinct locations.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently between the two 'Popular right now' cards—one has a white/light appearance while the other appears dark-filled, which may confuse users about favorite state.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent heart icon style and clearly differentiate the selected vs unselected favorite states across all cards.
